title: Mimicry
description:
Mimicry is a minimalist 2D puzzle-platformer where you control 2 characters at once in 100 levels.
However, one character's controls are inverted, so each level feels like a puzzle. 

- Control 2 characters that move in opposite directions at the same time.

- Oh! One of those characters ALSO has reversed gravity.

- Play 100 levels with 5 boss fights that will test your puzzle-solving and platforming skills.

- A very unique final boss fight that is not like most out there. 

- Not a gamer? No problem! The game's training wheels help you get ready to complete your journey.

- You are a gamer and want challenging puzzles? No problem! Good luck!

- Minimalist art and relaxing music to help cut the tension in the tougher stages.

Update: To backout in the home menus, press “Backspace” on PC or “Delete” on MAC. 
Gamepad controllers is my preferred way to play
